title: ORBIT BOARD v1.2.3 IS LIVE
summary: Orbit Board v1.2.3 introduces instant Bengali number pad toggle, live real-time keyboard resizer, theme accent spacebar, voice mic sound mute, and background push notifications.
highlights: Bangla Number Pad: Instant switch between English and Bengali numbers on dialpad
Real-Time Resizer: Live interactive preview while adjusting height and margins
Adaptive Spacebar: Matches theme accent with clean border options
Push Notifications: Background update alerts via WorkManager
